subject.title: feat: cross-gateway sessions_send and sessions_spawn via gateway.peers

question: Should this `gateway.peers` session-tool approach become the core cross-gateway contract, or should this PR be paused/closed in favor of the broader federation and security design issues?
rationale: The patch changes gateway URL policy, cross-gateway session ownership, message delivery, and credentials handling, which requires maintainer product and security intent before a repair bot can choose the final API shape.

options.title: Pause For Federation Contract

options.title: Sponsor A Narrow Rework
options.body: Allow this PR to continue only after maintainers define a narrow configured-peer contract and require the author to fix the blockers and add real multi-gateway proof.
